subject: Marketplace preflight: claim certification & ops gap remediation plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: NimbusCloud Ops <ops@nimbuscloud.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace preflight: claim certification & ops data request

Hi Julia / Nimbus team,

Quick preflight for the AWS marketplace listing and co-sell intake. We need to confirm a few items before we can submit the listing and request co-sell enablement:

- Trademark / branding authorization (company-signed letter)
- Supported regions and documented SLA windows by region (production and support hours)
- Any customer-facing claim language you will require us to use (short bullets)
- Contact for technical co-sell enablement and an ops escalation path (email + phone)

I've attached our preflight checklist (rif_preflight_checklist_v1.pdf) to speed this along. Can you return the trademark letter and a support coverage matrix by end of day Monday (PST)? If there are gaps on EU hours or SRE on-call, flag them up so we can propose mitigations.

Next steps from our side: Laura / Karthik, I'll loop you into their responses for legal and listing ops.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: rif_preflight_checklist_v1.pdf

From: Julia Park <julia.park@nimbuscloud.io>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: NimbusCloud Ops <ops@nimbuscloud.io>
Date: 2027-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace preflight: claim certification & ops data request

Ben — thanks for the checklist. Attaching a draft trademark authorization and our support coverage export. Quick notes:

- Attached: nimbus_trademark_letter_draft.pdf (we can sign formally once you confirm final claim language)
- Attached: nimbus_support_matrix.csv (hours listed by region)

Gaps you should know about: we do not currently have 24x7 EU phone support; EU primary coverage is business hours with on-call escalation to engineers (90min target). We can offer an SLA backstop via our partner support add-on (paid), or you can reference our Dedicated Support add-on for enterprise customers.

Co-sell contact: ops@nimbuscloud.io; for technical ramp, cc our Partner Engineer (pe@nimbuscloud.io) and I'll introduce the account lead if you want a joint demo.

Let us know if you prefer we pre-fill claim bullets for the marketplace listing.

—Julia
Partner Ops Lead | NimbusCloud

Attachment: nimbus_trademark_letter_draft.pdf, nimbus_support_matrix.csv

On Mon, Oct 18, 2027 at 09:12 AM Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick preflight for the AWS marketplace listing and co-sell intake. We need to confirm a few items before we can submit the listing and request co-sell enablement: ...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia.park@nimbuscloud.io>
Date: 2027-10-18T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace preflight: claim certification & ops data request

Laura / team — forwarding Nimbus' materials. Two immediate things I want us to decide:

1) Trademark authorization: Julia sent a draft; Legal should confirm this covers the listing copy we plan to submit. Laura, can you triage?
2) EU support gap: they call out no 24x7 phone in EU; we need an approach that satisfies marketplace policy without blocking listing. Options: a) request an exception/footnote on the listing, b) require Nimbus to enable partner add-on (commercial), c) Redwood provides a backstop via Dedicated/Triage for co-sell deals until Nimbus adds coverage.

Action items: Karthik, can you estimate the operational impact (routing, escalation, on-call overlap)? Monica, can you draft a short support routing playbook we can present to AWS listing ops to show mitigation? I'm tentatively scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks — Ben

Attachment referenced: nimbus_trademark_letter_draft.pdf, nimbus_support_matrix.csv

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-10-18T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace preflight: claim certification & ops data request

Thanks for the flag, Ben. Quick legal read: the draft trademark letter looks fine at a glance but we need to ensure the exact phrasing of the product claim is included ("Redwood Inference integrates with NimbusCloud for ..."). I attached a short list of questions for Nimbus to answer so Legal can sign off (legal_trademark_qs.docx).

On the EU support gap — recommend we pursue a two-track remediation plan:

- Short-term: present AWS marketplace ops with a mitigation annex showing (1) Nimbus' current hours, (2) Redwood's Dedicated backstop plan with SLA terms (we draft an ops playbook), and (3) a customer-facing footnote clarifying regional support hours. This typically satisfies marketplace reviewers if combined with a timeline for product change.
- Mid-term: work with Nimbus to commit to expanded EU on-call coverage within 90 days (we'll condition co-sell enablement on that roadmap).

Karthik: please prepare an ops gap matrix (expected routing, estimated costs for Redwood backstop) by EOD tomorrow. Monica: please start the support routing playbook; I'll add the legal Qs and then we'll send a combined packet to marketplace-ops@aws.amazon.com.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal & Marketplace Programs | Redwood Inference

Attachment: legal_trademark_qs.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@nimbuscloud.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Bcc: marketplace-ops@aws.amazon.com
Date: 2027-10-19T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace preflight: claim certification & ops data request — remediation plan and next steps

Julia — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Laura's note, here's our remediation plan and timeline: 

1) Legal sign-off: Laura will confirm final phrasing by EOD Oct 19.
2) Short-term mitigation packet: Karthik & Monica will produce the ops gap matrix and support routing playbook by Oct 20; we will bundle Nimbus' draft trademark letter and support matrix and submit to AWS marketplace ops the same day.
3) Mid-term commitment: Nimbus to provide a 90-day roadmap for EU on-call coverage; Redwood will tentatively offer Dedicated backstop pricing for any customers who require 24x7 phone support during the transition.

Links: review folder (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_preflight-evidence
DocuSign (co-sell agreement to follow): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-nimbus-co-sell-agreement

Julia, please confirm you accept the timeline and whether Nimbus will sign the trademark letter after Legal confirms final copy. Once you confirm, we'll submit the mitigation packet to marketplace-ops@aws.amazon.com and track the ticket.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: support_routing_playbook_draft.md (to follow)
